\section*{S1. Register of corrections}
Corrections made during the study on which numbers of the paper depend: defects of the earlier pipeline corrected in this one (items 1–3) and defects of the pipeline of this study found and corrected before any accepted number (items 8–13). Items 4–7 and 14–20 concern the traceability of the earlier report ~\cite{motion2026uc04}: no number of this paper depends on them, and they are listed in the register in the repository. Source: \texttt{protocol/\allowbreak{}paper4/\allowbreak{}REGISTRO\_\allowbreak{}CORREZIONI.\allowbreak{}md} (979bb29cb58be054).
